note: DRAFT for review, not yet a bundled parameter file. Swiss tax and pension parameters for 2026, in nominal CHF of 2026. The cantons offered are Zurich (ZH) and Ticino (TI), under cantons; the others are kept under cantonsNotOffered for later. Official pages could not be opened from the research environment; values come from web-search extracts of the official pages named in each source, or from the secondary sources named. Objects flagged verify need checking against the official text; objects flagged complete:false are missing values that a module can't run without. See docs/tax/CH.md.

single.note: Marginal rates of Art. 36 para. 1 DBG; the tax is at most 11.5% of the whole income, which binds from about 793,900. The official table gives 10,936.55 at 185,100, which these brackets reproduce (exact to 5 centimes with the table's rounding); a second extract gives 2,684.35 at 100,000 (2,684.44 continuous). The 2026 adjustment was 0.1% and the limits are rounded to 100 francs, so limits below 50,000 can't move (0.1% of 50,000 is 50); the match at 185,100 checks the sum of the bracket widths above them. Remaining check: compare each limit with Form 58c 2026.
single.source: DBG Art. 36 para. 1 and Art. 39 (cold progression). ESTV, Form. 58c 2026 Alleinstehende: https://www.estv.admin.ch/dam/de/sd-web/gnde9CmEsalK/dbst-tairfe-58c-2026-dfi.pdf. EFD, 0.1% inflation for 2026: https://www.efd.admin.ch/de/newnsb/VzaAUrhkPx2EPde4a6e3O. Tax at 100,000: calcswiss (secondary, search extract): https://calcswiss.ch/steuerrechner/zuerich/

nextAdjustment.source: EFD, Steuertarife und -abzuege an Teuerung angepasst (tax year 2027): https://www.efd.admin.ch/de/newnsb/rq9rumbCaofX

professionalExpenses.note: Flat deduction for other professional expenses, as a share of net salary. Commuting and meals are separate (otherDeductions).
professionalExpenses.source: Berufskostenverordnung (SR 642.118.1) Art. 7; ESTV, Berufskosten: https://www.estv2.admin.ch/stp/sm/berufskosten-de-fr.pdf. No change for 2026 (EFD).

commutingMaximum.source: DBG Art. 26 para. 1 lit. a; Kanton Zuerich, ZStB 26.1 (federal cap quoted there): https://www.zh.ch/de/steuern-finanzen/steuern/treuhaender/steuerbuch/steuerbuch-definition/zstb-26-1.html

insurancePremiums.note: Single person. 'with' applies to anyone paying into the 2nd pillar or 3a in the year; 'without' (half as much again, by law) to everyone else, so to retirees and the non-employed. The planner always takes the maximum (health insurance alone exceeds it).
insurancePremiums.source: DBG Art. 33 para. 1 lit. g and para. 1bis (the amounts rise by half without 2nd-pillar or 3a contributions). 1,800 confirmed for 2026 by search extracts; 2,700 = 1.5 x 1,800.

capitalBenefits.note: Capital benefits from pensions (2nd pillar, vested benefits, 3a) are taxed separately, all of a year's together, at 1/5 of the ordinary tariff.
capitalBenefits.source: DBG Art. 38. Proposal to raise it (Entlastungspaket 27) rejected by both chambers (Dec 2025, Mar 2026): https://www.bdo.ch/de-ch/publikationen/kapitalbezug-vorsorge-steuererhoehung-abgelehnt

dividends.note: Partial taxation of dividends from holdings of at least 10%; other dividends fully taxable.
dividends.source: DBG Art. 20 para. 1bis (as amended by STAF, from 2020)

lumpSumTaxation.note: Taxation on expenditure: the base is at least the highest of the minimum, 7 x the yearly rent or rental value, and the household's living expenses. 434,700 in 2025.
lumpSumTaxation.source: DBG Art. 14. Kanton Uri, Merkblatt Aufwandbesteuerung ab 1.1.2026: https://www.ur.ch/_docn/439772/14_Merkblatt_Aufwandbesteuerung_01.01.2026_1.pdf

employee.note: AHV 4.35%, IV 0.7%, EO 0.25% each side; no ceiling. ALV 1.1% each side up to 148,200; no solidarity contribution above since 2023. Working after the reference age: the first 16,800 a year is free.
employee.source: AHVG Art. 5 and 6; IVG Art. 3; EOG Art. 27; AVIG Art. 3. BSV, Betraege gueltig ab 1. Januar 2026: https://www.bsv.admin.ch/dam/de/sd-web/sAgdISSXenMT/d_Betr%C3%A4ge%202026.pdf; SECO, ALV-Beitraege: https://www.seco.admin.ch/dam/seco/de/dokumente/Arbeit/ALV/Grundlagen/Faktenblatt_ALV-Beitr%C3%A4ge.pdf.download.pdf/DE_Faktenblatt_ALV-Beitr%C3%A4ge.pdf

selfEmployed.note: AHV 8.1%, IV 1.4%, EO 0.5%. Between 10,100 and 60,500 the official scale rises in steps from 5.371% to 10%; the module interpolates linearly (a few francs' difference). Below 10,100 the minimum contribution applies.
selfEmployed.source: AHVG Art. 8; AHVV Art. 21. AHV/IV, Merkblatt 2.02: https://www.ahv-iv.ch/p/2.02.d; BSV tables: https://sozialversicherungen.admin.ch/de/d/6139/download?version=12

nonEmployed.note: Base: net wealth at 31 December (cantonal tax values, less debts, without 2nd pillar and 3a) + 20 x the year's pension income (all pensions incl. foreign and BVG; not IV pensions or supplementary benefits). Below 350,000 the minimum applies. The step contributions (636 at 350,000; 3,604 at 1,750,000) follow from the published increments and reproduce the maximum at 8,950,000. Due from 1 January after the 20th birthday to the reference age. Compensation offices add admin costs of up to 5%.
nonEmployed.source: AHVG Art. 10; AHVV Art. 28. AHV/IV, Merkblatt 2.03: https://www.ahv-iv.ch/p/2.03.d; SVA Aargau, Beitraege fuer Nichterwerbstaetige 2026: https://www.sva-aargau.ch/ueber-uns/jahresinformation-2026/fuer-privatpersonen/aenderungen-1-januar-2026/beitraege-fuer

indexed.source: AHVG Art. 9bis and 33ter (with the pensions, mixed index of wages and prices)

formula.note: Monthly pension with a full record: fixed share x minimum pension + variable share x average yearly income (13/600 up to 36 x the minimum, 8/600 above), between the minimum and the maximum pension. Partial pension: x Swiss contribution years / 44.

thirteenthPayment.note: Paid each December, 1/12 of the year's old-age pension (first time December 2026).

revaluationFactor.note: For first entries in the individual account from 1986 to 2025, for pensions starting in 2026: earnings count at their nominal value.

earlyWithdrawal.note: 6.8% a year for life (13.6% for two years). New rates based on life expectancy are expected at the earliest for 2027, lower for small incomes.
earlyWithdrawal.source: AHVG Art. 40; AHVV Art. 56. AK Bern, Flexibler Rentenbezug: https://www.akbern.ch/de/AHV-21/Flexibler-Rentenbezug/Flexibler-Rentenbezug.html

deferral.note: Supplement for 1 to 5 years of deferral.

adjustment2027.note: Pensions rise about 1.59% on 1 January 2027 (mixed index). Belongs in 2027.json.

euDeparture.note: Moving to an EU/EFTA state where the person is compulsorily insured for old age: only the over-mandatory part can be paid out in cash.

single.note: Simple wealth tax; the 0 band is the tax-free amount. Steps sum to 3,262,000 as stated. TI.description: Ticino; capital Bellinzona; complete for a single person (the married cantonal tariff is in, the federal one isn't)

single.note: Simple cantonal tax (imposta cantonale base) for 'altri contribuenti': single, widowed, separated and divorced people without children in the household (art. 35 cpv. 1). The law taxes income 'per categorie': each category of taxable income (rounded down to 100 francs) is taxed at its rate, so the categories are marginal brackets. These are the rates indexed from tax period 2025, still current in the ESTV's February 2026 sheet. The marginal rates aren't monotonic (3.923% after 5.949%; 11.597% after 11.8%): that is the law. Each row was read separately; each official tax reproduces from the one before and the category rates to within 30 centimes (the table's own rounding), and the effective rates given (1.588% at 17,400 ... 12.319% at 380,600) match. The tax at 52,700 wasn't read (3,245.52 computed; its effective rate of 6.158% was). The last rate is the 2025 maximum; every rate is capped by maximumCategoryRate.
single.source: LT art. 35 cpv. 1 (Legge tributaria del 21 giugno 1994, as amended by the reform approved on 9 June 2024): https://m3.ti.ch/CAN/RLeggi/public/index.php/raccolta-leggi/pdfatto/atto/5421. ESTV, Foglio cantonale TI (state February 2026), read row by row through web-search extracts: https://www.estv2.admin.ch/stp/kb/ti-it.pdf

married.note: Married couples living together, and single, widowed, separated or divorced people living with minor children (or children in training up to 28) or dependants (art. 35 cpv. 2 and 5). Same method and indexation as the single tariff. Rows read separately; each official tax reproduces from the one before and the category rates to within 30 centimes; the effective rates match. Not checked against an official figure: the tax on the first category (29.58 computed), at 90,400 and at 380,600, and the start of the last two categories (the same limits as the single tariff, 227,900 and 380,700, which one extract may have mixed up).
married.source: LT art. 35 cpv. 2 and 5 (as above). ESTV, Foglio cantonale TI (state February 2026), read row by row through web-search extracts: https://www.estv2.admin.ch/stp/kb/ti-it.pdf

maximumCategoryRate.note: Transitional derogation from art. 35 cpv. 1 and 2: no category is taxed above this rate (from 15.076% in 2024 to 12% in 2030, 0.5 points a year; the reform also cut every rate by 1.667%). The module applies min(rate, cap) to every category; whether the cap reaches below the last category (in 2026 only the 14.04% category, worth at most 61 francs) is to verify.
maximumCategoryRate.source: LT art. 35 (deroghe per i periodi fiscali 2025-2030), reform approved by the voters on 9 June 2024. ESTV, Foglio cantonale TI (extract: 'per il periodo fiscale 2026 l'aliquota massima di categoria e pari al 14 per cento'); Steimle Consulting, Riforma fiscale cantonale (February 2025, secondary): https://steimle-consulting.ch/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Riforma-fiscale-cantonale.pdf; CdT: https://www.cdt.ch/news/la-fiscalita-ticinese-dopo-le-riforme-ecco-dove-siamo-e-dove-arriveremo-434682

indexed.note: The Consiglio di Stato compensates cold progression by moving the categories and deductions with the cumulative inflation since the last adjustment (2024: +2.5% since 2012, first category 12,000 -> 12,300; 2025: first category 12,500). The Gran Consiglio kept full compensation. Trigger and article to verify.
indexed.source: Consiglio di Stato, Compensazione della progressione a freddo (2024): https://www4.ti.ch/tich/area-media/comunicati/dettaglio-comunicato/?NEWS_ID=231489; ticinonews, La progressione a freddo sara ancora compensata integralmente: https://www.ticinonews.ch/ticino/la-progressione-a-freddo-sara-ancora-compensata-integralmente-401968

single.note: Simple cantonal wealth tax by categories (art. 49 LT): 1 per mille up to 200,000, 2 to 280,000, 2.5 to 700,000, 3 to 1,380,000, and above it a proportional 2.5 per mille of the whole wealth (the bracket form gives the same: 3,450 is 2.5 per mille of 1,380,000). Net wealth below 200,000 isn't taxed (a threshold, so a cliff of 200 simple tax at 200,000, *verify* that it's a threshold and not an allowance). Wealth social deductions for couples (60,000) and children (30,000) are in one extract; another gives a 400,000 threshold for couples. Single only for now.
single.source: LT art. 48-49 (reform 2020: maximum rate from 3.5 to 2.5 per mille). ESTV, Foglio cantonale TI, read through web-search extracts: https://www.estv2.admin.ch/stp/kb/ti-it.pdf; the same scale quoted in the Verdi del Ticino initiative: https://verditicino.ch/finanza-fiscalita/iniziativa-elaborata-per-delle-aliquote-fiscali-sulla-sostanza-piu-eque/

brake.note: Freno all'imposta sulla sostanza: on request, the cantonal and communal tax on income and wealth together is reduced to 60% of the taxable income, where the net yield on wealth counts as at least 1% of net wealth (the shortfall is added to the income). Rarely binds: wealth tax alone is at most 0.25% x (1 + communal multiplier) of wealth, below 0.6% of it.
brake.source: LT art. 49a. Divisione delle contribuzioni, Applicazione nuovo art. 49a LT (via search extract): https://m4.ti.ch/fileadmin/DFE/DC/DOC-PRASSI/Applicazione_nuovo_art._49a_LT.pdf; PM Group: https://www.pm-group.ch/news/svizzera-freno-allimposta-sulla-sostanza-introduzione-dellart-49a/

church.note: No church tax is collected with the cantonal tax (from memory); a parish tax, where levied, is a custom multiplier.

multipliers.note: The cantonal coefficient is 100% (back from 97% in 2024). Communal multipliers 2026 for individuals (persone fisiche): Lugano raised from 77% to 80%; Bellinzona, Locarno, Mendrisio and Chiasso unchanged. The cantonal average is 82.7% (median 85%). The communal tax is the simple cantonal tax x the communal multiplier, for income, wealth and capital benefits alike.
multipliers.source: ESTV, Foglio cantonale TI (extract: coefficient 100% for 2026); CdT, Moltiplicatori d'imposta, anche quest'anno vince Porza (2026): https://www.cdt.ch/news/economia/moltiplicatori-dimposta-anche-questanno-vince-porza-440391; Lugano: bluewin, https://www.bluewin.ch/it/attualita/regionali/2026-lugano-alza-il-moltiplicatore-2930484.html and laRegione, https://www.laregione.ch/cantone/luganese/1892600/moltiplicatore-pse-lugano-cinque-consiglieri-emendamento-imposta-aumento; Bellinzona, MM 1015 Preventivi 2026: https://www.bellinzona.ch/MM-1015-Bilanci-Preventivi-2026-9dd30000?i=1; Locarno, Preventivi 2026: https://www.locarno.ch/files/documenti/CS_Preventivi_2026.pdf; list: https://www4.ti.ch/dfe/dc/sportello/moltiplicatori-comunali

personalTax.note: Imposta personale, from memory: CHF 40 a year per taxpayer of 18 or more. No extract confirmed it.

conversionTable.note: The ESTV's table converting a capital into the life annuity it buys (values from 2005), per 1,000 of capital. Only age 65 is in the draft (two extracts agree); copy ages 55-70 for both sexes. Until then the module uses the 65 values at every age: the rate only matters between the 2% and 3% bounds.
conversionTable.source: ESTV, Tabelle zur Umrechnung von Kapitalleistungen in lebenslaengliche Renten (2005): https://www.estv.admin.ch/dam/estv/de/dokumente/dbst/tarife/dbst-tairfe-leib-2005-de.pdf.download.pdf/dbst-tairfe-leib-2005-de.pdf; copy in the Schwyz tax office's documentation: https://www.sz.ch/public/upload/assets/16785/Tabelle_zur_Umrechnung_von_Kapitalleistungen_in_lebenslaengliche_Renten.pdf?fp=5

capitalBenefits.note: Art. 38 cpv. 2 LT: all of a year's capital benefits are taxed together at the rate the tariff gives on the life annuity they would buy (amount x the conversion factor for the person's age and sex, rounded down to 100), at least 2% and, since 2025, at most 3%. The bounds apply to the simple cantonal tax; the communal tax is that simple tax x the communal multiplier (Lugano 2025: 3% + 2.31% at 77% + 2.30% federal = 7.61%). For a single person at 65 (male factor) the 2% floor binds up to about 378,000 and the 3% cap from about 555,000. Reproduces the Bellinzona totals: 250,000 -> 13,550.69 (2% floor); 500,000 -> annuity 25,300, rate 2.5896%, 35,490.34.
capitalBenefits.source: LT art. 38 cpv. 2 (as amended by the reform of 9 June 2024). Divisione delle contribuzioni, circolare 3/2006 (method and conversion table; example 450,000 x 43.78 per mille): https://m4.ti.ch/fileadmin/DFE/DC/DOC-CIRC/circ_2006_03.pdf; Novita fiscali, dicembre 2024: https://novitafiscali.ch/articoli/2024/n0-12-dicembre-2024/limposizione-dei-prelievi-in-capitale-dalla-previdenza-in-ticino-il-nuovo-art-38-cpv-2-lt; LCA, Ticino Cantonal Tax Reform (cap from 1 January 2025; Lugano 7.61%): https://www.lca-tax.ch/en/canton-ticino-riforma-della-legge-tributaria-focus-imposizione-delle-prestazioni-in-capitale-della-previdenza/; Steimle Consulting (same split): https://steimle-consulting.ch/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Riforma-fiscale-cantonale.pdf; geldfuchs (secondary): https://geldfuchs.ch/steuern/kapitalbezug/
